description: This bar chart illustrates the relationship between model type and self-report accuracy preferences. The horizontal axis represents the model type, with categories labeled “GPT-4o” and “GPT-4o-mini” in that order, and the vertical axis represents “Self-Report Accuracy Preferences (Instilled Preferences)” with a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 1.00, with tick marks at 0.25 intervals. Three bars are present for each model type, representing the conditions “Control” (light blue), “Before Introspection Training” (medium blue), and “After Introspection Training” (purple). For GPT-4o, the “Control” bar extends to approximately 0.62, the “Before Introspection Training” bar extends to approximately 0.74, and the “After Introspection Training” bar extends to approximately 0.82. For GPT-4o-mini, the “Control” bar extends to approximately 0.04, the “Before Introspection Training” bar extends to approximately 0.08, and the “After Introspection Training” bar extends to approximately 0.80. Each bar is accompanied by a black error bar indicating variability. The bars are arranged side-by-side, grouped by model type, and no bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
